capabilities: Navigate headings via floating margin dashes
Preview section excerpts with KaTeX math on hover
Jump to chapters in reading and editing views with pinned-top scrolling
Search and jump between chapters via a command palette
Store local reading progress and chapter bookmarks
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; install via BRAT or a GitHub Release. Desktop-only (minAppVersion 1.8.7, no mobile support claimed).
problem: Obsidian's outline sidebar takes permanent screen space, and long technical notes lack a compact margin-based way to see and jump between sections.
summary: Floating outline rail that renders headings as margin dashes with KaTeX hover previews, pinned-top chapter jumps, and local reading bookmarks.
